Verdict: No specific board-level connection defect found in the reviewed reset, size, polarity and pin paths.
VerdictChinese: 在本次审查的复位、时钟连接、尺寸、极性及引脚路径中未发现具体连接错误。

Checks.ResetClock: DDR controller receives global_reset_n independently of pipeline_release and provides the System core_clk. Continuous sensor/DDR/PLL/TX qualification releases the pipeline once; runtime faults latch and stop admissions without withdrawing pipeline_reset_n. Camera, core and pixel children share the pipeline reset and use their existing local release synchronizers.
Checks.Polarity: VSYNC_ACTIVE_HIGH=0, HREF_ACTIVE_HIGH=0 and HIGH_BYTE_FIRST=0 propagate through all three wrappers to dvp_rgb565_capture_cdc. This matches raw_camera_capture_cam2_ref VS/HREF inversions and camera_live_bridge LOW-byte-first assembly.
Checks.SensorSetup: DYNAMIC_PAD_MASK=1 with 0x7ff0; table final 3808..380b values are 02/80/01/e0, 4300=6f, 501f=01, 4740=23. Init readback checks the same values. Reset/SCL/SDA retain open-drain interfaces.
Checks.Pins: All 14 camera pad/electrical attributes match the historical CAM2 reference; explicit directions match the new top. D5=AA23, PCLK=U21, VSYNC=V23, HREF=W23.
Checks.WrapperDerivation: DMA and write-link differences from the existing HDMI versions are limited to module/port names, VGA defaults and byte-wide DVP capture hookup. System additionally passes independent OUTPUT_WIDTH/OUTPUT_HEIGHT to AW/AH, preserving the full 1080 active window.

Limits: Camera hardware and this candidate bitstream have not been validated. This review is not synthesis, routing, timing, CDC physical, DDR PHY or HDMI acceptance.
Existing control proof uses status stubs, an 8 ms warmup and accelerated power counter; it does not prove real SCCB initialization, native VGA DVP integration or sustained frame throughput.
Camera ready is initialization completion, not a live PCLK/VS watchdog. Missing or stopped camera/core clocks have no independent recovery here; shared manual reset remains the recovery boundary.
48 MHz PCLK and 0..5 ns camera input timing in the diagnostic constraints remain provisional; actual board sampling margin and generated CDC/reset paths require physical review.
Default zero-distortion geometry is transport validation, not calibrated lens correction. Real-System bench work remains owned by camera_dvp_system and is not judged by this control review.
